sentences.text: Legion is an American cable television series created for FX by Noah Hawley , based on the Marvel Comics character David Haller / Legion .	Noah Hawley	Noah Hawley	Legion	Legion (Marvel Comics)	FX	FX (TV channel)	cable television	cable television	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	David Haller / Legion	Legion (Marvel Comics)

It is connected to the X-Men film series , the first television series to be so , and is produced by FX Productions in association with Marvel Television .	Marvel Television	Marvel Television	FX Productions	Fox Entertainment Group	FX	FX (TV channel)	X-Men	X-Men
Hawley serves as showrunner on the series .	showrunner	showrunner
Dan Stevens stars as Haller , a mutant diagnosed with schizophrenia at a young age .	Dan Stevens	Dan Stevens	mutant	Mutant (Marvel Comics)	schizophrenia	schizophrenia

Rachel Keller , Aubrey Plaza , Bill Irwin , Jeremie Harris , Amber Midthunder , Katie Aselton , and Jean Smart also star .	Rachel Keller	Rachel Keller (actress)	Aubrey Plaza	Aubrey Plaza	Bill Irwin	Bill Irwin	Amber Midthunder	Amber Midthunder	Katie Aselton	Katie Aselton	Jean Smart	Jean Smart

FX and Marvel Television announced a new collaboration to create a television series based on the X-Men character Legion in October 2015 , with Hawley signed on to write , and direct the pilot .	Legion	Legion (Marvel Comics)	Marvel Television	Marvel Television	FX	FX (TV channel)	X-Men	X-Men
Casting began by January 2016 , and filming took place in Vancouver .	Vancouver	Vancouver

Hawley wanted to show Haller as an `` unreliable narrator '' , including mixing 1960s design with modern-day elements , and filming the series through the title character 's distorted view of reality .	unreliable narrator	unreliable narrator

The eight-episode first season of Legion premiered at the Pacific Design Center on January 26 , 2017 , ahead of its FX debut on February 8 .	Legion	Legion (Marvel Comics)	FX	FX (TV channel)	first season	Legion (season 1)	Pacific Design Center	Pacific Design Center
The series received critical acclaim , particularly for its visuals and departure from superhero genre standards .
A second season , of ten episodes , was ordered in March 2017 and is planned for a February 2018 release .
